extra_vocab.en: a person who works with you at the same company
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於辦公室對話、電子郵件與公告，指在同一個公司或團隊工作的人。語氣自然、不分職位高低，比 colleague 稍口語。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 也可以寫成 co-worker（有連字號），兩種拼法都對；它是可數名詞，單數前要加 a 或 my。

example.en: My coworkers organized a farewell lunch for the retiring manager.
example.zh: 我的同事們為即將退休的經理辦了一場歡送午餐。

example.en: It is important to get along with your coworkers.
example.zh: 與同事相處融洽很重要。

example.en: If you have questions, ask a coworker for help.
example.zh: 如果有問題，請向同事求助。

example.en: A former coworker recommended me for this position.
example.zh: 一位前同事推薦我來應徵這個職位。

examples.en: I share a small office with two coworkers.
examples.zh: 我和兩位同事共用一間小辦公室。

examples.en: Please forward this message to your coworkers in the sales team.
examples.zh: 請把這則訊息轉寄給業務團隊的同事。

examples.en: How do you handle disagreements with a coworker?
examples.zh: 你如何處理與同事的意見不合？

similar.diff: colleague 稍正式，常用在專業人士之間；coworker 較口語，任何職位都可以用。

example.en: I discussed the proposal with a colleague from the legal department.
example.zh: 我和法務部的一位同事討論了這份提案。

similar.diff: teammate 指同一個小組或專案的成員；coworker 只要在同公司就可以。

example.en: Each teammate is responsible for one part of the report.
example.zh: 每位組員負責報告的其中一部分。

example.en: Please ask your supervisor to approve the leave request.
example.zh: 請請你的主管核准請假申請。

example.en: Every employee must attend the safety training.
example.zh: 每位員工都必須參加安全訓練。

example.en: She introduced me to an associate from the Tokyo office.
example.zh: 她把我介紹給東京辦公室的一位同事。

extra_vocab.en: growing bigger as more is added over time
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於財務報告、銷售數據與成績計算，例如 cumulative total（累計總額）。強調「一點一點加起來」，也可形容影響逐漸累積，如 cumulative effect。

example.en: The cumulative total for this year has reached two million dollars.
example.zh: 今年的累計總額已達兩百萬美元。

example.en: Cumulative sales of the new phone passed one million units.
example.zh: 新手機的累計銷量已超過一百萬支。

example.en: The cumulative effect of small delays can be serious.
example.zh: 小小延誤累積起來的效應可能很嚴重。

examples.en: The cumulative profit for the first half was higher than expected.
examples.zh: 上半年的累計獲利比預期還高。

examples.en: Your final grade is based on the cumulative score of all tests.
examples.zh: 你的最終成績是依所有測驗的累計分數計算。

examples.en: The chart shows the cumulative number of orders each month.
examples.zh: 這張圖表顯示每月的累計訂單數。

confusable.diff: 拼法相近，但 consecutive 是「連續的」，指一個接一個；cumulative 是「累積的」，指加總起來。

example.en: Sales rose for three consecutive months this spring.
example.zh: 今年春天銷售連續三個月成長。

similar.diff: total 只是「總計的」；cumulative 強調隨時間逐步加起來的過程。

example.en: The total cost of the project was lower than planned.
example.zh: 專案的總成本比計畫的低。

similar.diff: accumulated 是過去分詞當形容詞，強調「已經累積起來的」；cumulative 更常用在數據與統計。

example.en: Her accumulated experience made her ideal for the role.
example.zh: 她累積下來的經驗讓她成為這個職位的理想人選。

example.en: The total of all invoices came to five thousand dollars.
example.zh: 所有發票加起來的總額是五千美元。

example.en: A large sum of money was spent on advertising.
On average, we receive fifty orders a day.
example.zh: 平均來說，我們每天收到五十筆訂單。
